title: hyper-design slop detector project configuration
description: Optional per-project configuration for scripts/detect-slop.sh. Re-authored from the mechanism idea in dbc-hbin/omp-ulw @ 74df40f (2026-11-09); no text or code was copied.

rules.description: Per-rule severity override or disablement. A severity value replaces the registry default in the report; off removes the rule from the scan.

allowFonts.description: Font families the project allows. All allowFonts, allowEasings, and designTokens values form one pooled allowlist: a finding whose matched excerpt contains any listed value moves to the skipped count instead of the findings list.

allowEasings.description: Named easing functions the project allows, for example cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1). All allowFonts, allowEasings, and designTokens values form one pooled allowlist: a finding whose matched excerpt contains any listed value moves to the skipped count instead of the findings list.

designTokens.description: Declared design tokens as name to CSS value map, for example colors and lengths the project standardizes on. All allowFonts, allowEasings, and designTokens values form one pooled allowlist: a finding whose matched excerpt contains any listed value moves to the skipped count instead of the findings list.
